purpose: Establish a reproducible starting point for R4 by running the current structured-minilm path on the frozen 24-case R3 development cohort and diffing it against the frozen R3.4 run. R4.0 changes no source file; it records behavior, attributes every difference, and gates every R3.5r change.

startingState.workingTreeSummary: R3.5r changes are present and uncommitted: retrieval-profile.ts, retrieval-target.ts, structured-ranking.ts, their tests, and r3/README.md. The closed R3.5r recovery line is untracked (r3/recovery/, recovery-score.mjs, recovery-screening.ts, recovery-screening.test.ts). Generated Prisma and Graphify changes are excluded from this record.

determinism.note: The pinned local MiniLM inference is bit-identical to the R3.4 capture. The scores file byte hash differs only because it stores model-load and rerank timings.

harness.note: The existing R3 capture/replay path was reused; no second scoring system was created. reportSupport calls scoreTarget unchanged.

decision.revertRationale: A broad revert is unsafe and unnecessary. The frozen query input hash is identical to R3.4, inference is bit-identical, route behavior is identical, and the only behavioral delta is six facet selections attributable to the F09 candidate change. R4.2a reproduces the defects; R4.2b implements only the three runtime fixes relative to this frozen baseline.
